subject: Marketly: intermittent brownout and throughput degradation
messages:
From: Evan Torres <evan.torres@marketly.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High p99 / 502s impacting checkout — sudden onset

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

We're seeing a sharp onset of failures and very long completion times for the Redwood API used by our checkout flow starting ~08:55 PDT. Symptoms:
- Total completion rate dropped ~45% for our tenant; many requests queue and then 502.
- p99 climbed from ~1.1s to ~7s; p95 also up.
- Error rate (5xx) jumped from 0.3% to ~4.6% around the same time.

We've attached a short sample of request/response IDs and a trace (marketly_support_logs_20261020.zip). Can you confirm if anything changed on your side (routing, concurrency, autoscaling, model changes) or whether this looks like an internal queue/backpressure problem?

We need a quick triage — this is customer-impacting (checkout).

Thanks,
Evan
Product Ops | Marketly
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Torres <evan.torres@marketly.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High p99 / 502s impacting checkout — sudden onset

Thanks Evan — sorry you're seeing this. We're triaging now and I've looped in Dev (SRE/runtime) and Jonas (ops lead). Short plan:
1) Dev will look at dispatcher queues, tenant-level concurrency, and recent routing changes.
2) We'll consider an emergency tenant-level concurrency cap and enable model-fallback to a lower-latency variant if available.
3) We'll purge/refresh any suspect KV cache entries for Marketly and examine prefix cache TTLs.

Can you forward the support logs and any request IDs you want prioritized? We'll update in the next 30-45 minutes.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: RE: High p99 / 502s impacting checkout — sudden onset

I'm looking at telemetry now (link: https://dd.ops.redwood.example.com/marketly/graphs?p90_p99=1). Quick findings:
- Dispatcher queue depth for Marketly spiked to ~2.1k concurrent queued requests around 08:56 PDT.
- Per-tenant concurrency cap was at 64 (recently increased 2026-10-19 03:44 UTC via routing-rollout A).
- KV-cache churn high; multiple TTL-expirations causing cold KV reads and effectively serializing some completion paths.
- There was a routing tweak yesterday that increased request fanout to a higher-capacity model variant; it may be causing heavier KV usage per request.

Immediate mitigations I recommend we can do in parallel:
- Apply a temporary tenant-level concurrency cap for Marketly to 24 (reduce in-band work and avoid dispatcher saturation).
- Enable the model-fallback policy so long-running requests route to the smaller/fast variant.
- Purge Marketly's per-tenant session KV caches (target stale sessions older than 15m).
- Increase prefix-caching TTL for common checkout prompts to reduce cold-KV hits (config: prefix_ttl=300 -> 900).

I'll post the exact commands to run in the ticket and stand by to roll the cap. If anyone objects to the cap number, propose 32 as a middle ground.

--- command snippets ---
# set tenant cap (ops tool)
opsctl tenant set-cap marketly concurrency=24 --reason="emergency brownout mitigation"
# enable model fallback
opsctl routing set-fallback marketly enable --target=fast-small-v2

Dev
Senior SRE, Runtime
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evan Torres <evan.torres@marketly.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 01:02:00 +00:00
Subject: ACTION: please execute tenant cap + fallback and confirm

Marissa / SRE on call — please execute Dev's plan now. Dev recommended cap=24 (we'll go with 24). Confirm once done and share immediate post-change metrics (p95/p99/error-rate) and the Jira ticket id so Marketly has a reference.

I've attached a short runbook excerpt (tenant-cap-runbook.pdf) and created JIRA-INF-7421 to track. Evan, we'll paste updates to the ticket as well.

Thanks,
Tessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evan Torres <evan.torres@marketly.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 01:45:00 +00:00
Subject: RE: ACTION: please execute tenant cap + fallback and confirm

Done — actions executed at 01:40 UTC:
- opsctl tenant set-cap marketly concurrency=24 (was 64)
- opsctl routing set-fallback marketly enable --target=fast-small-v2
- purged tenant KV entries older than 15m
- increased prefix_ttl for marketly checkout prompts to 600s

Immediate impact (1:40 -> 01:44 UTC):
- p99 reduced from ~6.8s -> ~1.2s for the checkout route
- p95 improved from ~1.8s -> ~0.9s
- 5xx error rate dropped from ~4.6% -> 0.6%

Attached: p99_trace_marketly_20261021.txt (sample traces) — most long tails were queuing-related. Residual elevated p95 appears related to very long-running sessions that still hit cold-KV paths; recommend follow-up patch to KV eviction strategy and a small canary rollback of the routing change from 2026-10-19.

Marissa
SRE, Production Runtime

- Impact (checkout conversions affected, estimated revenue delta if possible, duration)
- Immediate mitigations taken and when (timestamps)
- Next actions (rollback/canary, KV eviction patch, longer-term routing config guardrails)
- Proposed customer remediation (service credit / CM package) and ownership (AE: Tessa)

Tessa — can you draft the slide and include the numbers Marissa captured? Keep it tight — 5 bullets + timeline. I'm looping our Head of Sales and CS in the exec sync; they want the slide by 15:00 PT today.

Jonas
